summary: A steam-era railway water tower: a 6.6 m wooden stave tank bound by seven iron hoops (closer at the bottom)… joints spout; options tank_paint; sockets track_side, spout_mouth.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.railway_water_tower or place "prefab": "railway_water_tower" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
